candidate.purpose: Near-real-time SEC filing retrieval and structured parsing for catalyst timing, dilution/financing and ownership signals
candidate.latencySuitability: MEDIUM-HIGH for SEC event timing; not a market-tick feed
candidate.securityNotes: Requires identifying SEC User-Agent. No credentials are required for public EDGAR access. AGPL creates distribution/network-use obligations if directly integrated into a served product.
candidate.lookAheadRisk: HIGH unless TAGX stores SEC acceptance/accession time as event-time and prevents amended/later XBRL facts from being joined backward into earlier snapshots.
candidate.integrationPlan: Do not add production dependency. Challenger should consume only the current-filings feed, persist accession/acceptance timestamp, form type and exhibit metadata, and benchmark catalyst lead-time and false attribution against current TAGX sec-catalyst sweep.
candidate.rejectionReasonForDirectProduction: AGPL license plus causal-timestamp/look-ahead controls require isolated benchmark first.
